conclusion: 528 MHz supports isolated 12-bit continuous ADC DMA at 33/28 MS/s per converter. Exact 1 MHz external triggering remains unqualified.
production_firmware_change: None retained; failed direct-divider variant reverted.
qualification_boundaries: Standalone characterization is not production memory-layout or wire-protocol acceptance.
Continuous tests exclude GPIO capture, USB data transport, checksum work and production framing.
Continuous ADCs started by separate software writes; 500 ns phase not established.
Soak counts aggregate DMA transfers; code-range inspection covers final buffers only.
No analog accuracy, aperture, controlled thermal or long-term reliability qualification.
ADC_ETC errors count observed status events and may coalesce; not exact lost-trigger counts.
DMA-to-HC0 fails 1 MHz even at 450 MHz where production ADC_ETC works; it does not isolate bare conversion latency.
